draft.summary: Current pricing at The Amber Court is consistently below the comp set, with BAR dropping up to 21% lower on key dates. The OTA channel contributes significantly to occupancy, occasionally reaching critical levels impacting visibility. Immediate actions should focus on balancing OTA reliance with direct bookings and addressing low ADR bookings. Careful management of rates through closing certain low-yield plans and setting minimum LOS can strengthen revenue, especially with available inventory before high-demand periods.
